IN_CEA_v21_FY2024_25.metric: Weighted average emission factor of the Indian grid (all stations incl. renewables and grid-connected captive, net generation weighted), FY 2024-25
IN_CEA_v21_FY2024_25.source: Central Electricity Authority, CO2 Baseline Database for the Indian Power Sector, Version 21.0 (User Guide dated Nov/Dec 2025)
IN_CEA_v21_FY2024_25.verification: The CEA PDF was behind a login page when accessed, so 0.710 tCO2/MWh is taken from secondary summaries of Version 21.0 (e.g. BEE/CCTS reference tables, which also give 0.727 for FY 2023-24 and so match the primary Version 20.0 figure below). One vendor summary reports 0.7117. Treat the third significant figure as unverified until checked against the CEA database's Results sheet.
IN_CEA_v21_FY2024_25.note: CEA has also published Version 22.0 (FY 2025-26, dated Aug/Sep 2026; https://cea.nic.in/wp-content/uploads/baseline/2026/09/User_Guide__Version_22.0.pdf), but its figures were not retrievable (login wall). Replace this default when they are.

IN_CEA_v20_FY2023_24.metric: Weighted average emission factor, FY 2023-24 (adjusted for cross-border transfers, incl. RES and captive injection), Table S
IN_CEA_v20_FY2023_24.source: Central Electricity Authority, CO2 Baseline Database for the Indian Power Sector, User Guide Version 20.0, December 2024
IN_CEA_v20_FY2023_24.verification: Read directly from Table S of the Version 20.0 user guide text (Average 0.727, OM 0.962, BM 0.552, CM 0.757 tCO2/MWh), via the public copy at https://static-cdn.publive.online/saur-energy/media/pdf_files/2025/01user_guide_version_20.0.pdf because the CEA site required a login.

IN_CEA_v20_CM_FY2023_24.metric: Combined margin (CDM marginal-style factor), FY 2023-24, Table S of Version 20.0. Use for a marginal-emissions sensitivity, not as the default.
